h1: Find the correct cylinder or electric-boiler manual
title: Cylinder & Electric-Boiler Manuals | Official Resources
description: Understand find the correct cylinder or electric-boiler manual with clear model-aware information and practical questions for your cylinder engineer.
answer: Start with the full model label and product generation. The correct manual is more useful than a generic reset video or a similar-looking parts listing.

sections.heading: The key distinction
paragraphs: The resource links below lead to manufacturer libraries for Heatrae Sadia, Megaflo, Gledhill, OSO, Joule and related Stelflow ranges, Telford, Vaillant, Worcester and Viessmann. Match the actual label, variant and manufacturing period.

sections.heading: Apply the information to the installed system
paragraphs: Manufacturer documents can contain engineer-only instructions. A manual being public does not make live electrical testing, safety-valve replacement or unvented commissioning suitable DIY tasks. Use the user section for normal operation and ask a competent engineer when a fault requires internal work.

sections.heading: A practical next question
paragraphs: Gather the full model, heating method, recent symptoms and available paperwork. Discuss the scope with a person competent for the actual work. Technical information here supports that conversation and is not a substitute for manufacturer instructions or individual system assessment.

faqs.question: Why can an older manual be the right reference for my cylinder?
faqs.answer: The installed generation may differ from current products; match the model and manufacturing period rather than assume the newest manual applies.
